notes.title: Free to Play
notes.content:
Sure! Here’s the text translated into English:

Dear Players,

After a challenging year filled with ups and downs, we are excited to finally make a significant announcement. We have been working hard on our game, and we are thrilled to announce that it is now free to play! 🎉

We sincerely apologize for the delay in this transition. Due to various technical difficulties and development challenges, it took longer than we originally anticipated. We greatly appreciate your patience and understanding during this time.

Your feedback and support have helped us through this challenging phase, and we are grateful to have such an engaged community. Now that our game is available as Free-to-Play, we invite all of you to join us in discovering the new content and experiencing the exciting adventures that await you.

We wish you all a fantastic time playing and look forward to seeing you in the game! Your feedback remains important to us, so please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts.

Thank you for your loyalty and understanding.

Your Madnex

notes.title: Hotfix and Costs Patch
notes.content:
-Last_Enemy List was an Error
- Sound for Rankpoints was to loud and Rank Up

-Cardpack costs are reduced from 300 to 250

notes.title: Magires Hotfix
notes.content: There was a bug that would heal the player if the magic resist value was too high

notes.title: Hotfix + Lastplayerlist
notes.content:
Last player list increased to 5 (fight 4 other players before fighting the same one).

Fixed silver rankup bug.

notes.title: Balancing Patch
notes.content:
- Shield nerfs 10 damage to 25 damage max reduction per hit.
- Fixed knight reflection bug.
- Fixed multiplayer server bug.
- Daily Crapies from 100 to 150.
